$comment: Frontier step 4: critique of the test PROTOCOL (not of a report), by another model family when one is configured. The critic's raw answer is kept in the working directory (raw_output) with its SHA-256; item texts and trap-verdict reasons must appear in it. Family rules, trap verdicts and items ([CRITIQUE]) are in tools/check.py.

no_independent_critic.description: true when no other family is available: the card then says 'Critique: same family (no independent critic available)'.

raw_output.description: Path, relative to the working directory, of the critic's raw answer, kept as received.

trap_verdicts.description: test id -> {proxy_vs_target, variants, positive_control, data_split} -> {verdict, why}; verdict addressed | not_addressed | unclear (not_returned: only on the vp-contradictor route, whose output has no trap verdicts).
